Strict whitespace mode preserves whitespace as-is

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"whitespace_mode\":\"Strict\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Preserved   spacing.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
